name: slider
title: Slider
description: Pick a number or a range on a track. Single or range thumbs (one per value), optional visible label and live value readout, two sizes, works inside Field and Form. The optional invalid prop exposes aria-invalid on every thumb input and destructive thumb borders; invalid Field works without the prop. Pair invalid with a FieldError or description explaining the allowed values; colour alone is insufficient. Set withInput to pair each thumb with a kit NumberInput on a fixed grid row. Typing within the bounds updates the slider immediately; blur or Enter clamps and snaps to the nearest step from min (1.37 becomes 1.4 with min 0 and step 0.1). Empty or unparsable text restores the current value without a change callback. Range inputs also clamp against neighbouring thumbs and respect minStepsBetweenValues. The slider remains the only named form control; paired inputs are isolated from Field validation and share the slider or thumb name. showValue is hidden while paired. inputProps accepts unit, hideSteppers and size; input size defaults to the slider size (md by default). See SliderWithInput for single, controlled and range examples. marks accepts numbers or { value, label?: string } entries; out-of-range marks are ignored. Ticks and labels are decorative, while labelled stops are announced in aria-valuetext. Use about five labels at most on narrow tracks; additional ticks can be unlabelled. restrictToMarks restricts thumb keyboard navigation only, including withInput: arrows, Shift+Arrow and Page keys move to the adjacent mark; Home/End choose the first/last allowed mark. Range minStepsBetweenValues is counted in marks for these keys. Dragging and paired input edits still use the regular step and numeric gap. See SliderMarks for labelled temperature stops and keyboard-restricted replicas.
author: gntik-ai
